title: Body metric
description: A dated body measurement or demographic value.

type.description: The metric type, such as WEIGHT, HEIGHT, BIRTHDAY, or GENDER.

value.description: The metric value in the canonical unit documented by the metric type.

unit.description: The canonical unit symbol, or null for categorical and date values.

provider.description: The external provider that supplied the value, when available.

effectiveDate.description: The date and time from which this value is effective in ISO 8601 format.

createdAt.description: The time the record was created in ISO 8601 format.

source.description: The system or user action that originally supplied this record.

sourceExternalId.description: The stable record identifier assigned by the source system, when available.

sourceUpdatedAt.description: The last modification time reported by the source system in ISO 8601 format.
